headline: Stop snacking today, prove you're serious now
summary: You're gaining 0.34kg weekly when you need to lose 0.79kg weekly; today ends the emotional eating pattern and starts your comeback.
details: Today: skip all vegan treat foods and emotional snacking triggers—replace with pre-portioned Huel meals only.
